answer: Each agent must anchor its identity to a unique ephemeris-derived optical beacon, so a sybil cannot wander across forged nodes without colliding on the shared phased-array timing signature. Relay constellations cross-check these beacons against a willow-like branching hash of orbital states, letting honest peers prune duplicates near any mesa relay before quorum. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
